wrong_pool.title: Your payment reached us
wrong_pool.body: We received your payment, but it went to a different pool than your assigned one. We can't move it across automatically. Tap 'Get help' and our helpdesk will sort it out with you.
amount_mismatch.title: Your payment reached us
amount_mismatch.body: We received your payment, but the amount didn't match this cycle's fixed contribution. We can't adjust it automatically. Tap 'Get help' and our helpdesk will sort it out with you.
active_contribution.title: My Pool
active_contribution.tone.calm: Your pool is open — contribute when you can
active_contribution.tone.calm_a11y: Your pool is open. You can contribute when you are ready.
active_contribution.tone.closing: Today is the final day. If you're able, please contribute to support {family}'s family
active_contribution.tone.closing_a11y: Today is the final day of this cycle. If you're able, please contribute to support {family}'s family.
contributor_list.title: Live pool
contributor_list.no_pool: You have no live pool right now.
contributor_list.pending_strip_a11y: {count} contributions pending confirmation, {percentage} percent of the pool
contributor_list.view_cta_hint: Opens the live contributor list for your pool
active_contribution.yellow_pill: You've told us you paid. We're checking it against our bank records and will confirm once it matches.
active_contribution.yellow_pill_a11y: You have told us you paid. We are still verifying it against our bank statement. This is not yet a confirmed payment.
upi_intent.title: Contribute to your pool
upi_intent.pay_cta_a11y: Pay your contribution using a UPI app
upi_intent.pay_cta_hint: Opens your UPI app to complete the payment
upi_intent.utr_prompt: After you pay, paste the UPI reference number (UTR) here.
upi_intent.utr_aria: UPI reference number, also called UTR
upi_intent.utr_invalid: That doesn't look like a UTR. It is usually 12 numbers, or 22 letters and numbers.
upi_intent.attest_error: We couldn't save that just now. Please try again, or tap Get help.
upi_intent.yellow_pill: Thank you. You've told us you paid, and we're now checking it against our bank records. We'll confirm once it matches.
upi_intent.yellow_pill_a11y: Thank you. You have told us you paid. We are still verifying it against our bank statement. This is not yet a confirmed payment.
upi_intent.load_failed: We couldn't load your payment details. Please try again.
upi_intent.switch_account_a11y: Switch to the nominee's other bank account for this payment
upi_intent.switch_account_error: We couldn't switch accounts just now. Please try again.
upi_intent.unavailable: UPI contribution isn't available for this pool yet. Tap Get help and we will guide you.
upi_intent.unassigned: You don't have a live pool to contribute to right now.
upi_intent.no_app_guidance: We couldn't find a UPI app on your phone. Install PhonePe, Google Pay, or BHIM — or pay another way and paste your UTR below.
upi_intent.launch_error: Something went wrong opening your UPI app. You can try again, or pay another way and paste your UTR below.
upi_intent.pool_changed_error: Your pool assignment changed. Please go back and try again.
upi_intent.session_expired_error: Your session has expired. Please log in again to continue.
upi_failure.prompt: Payment didn't go through? Tell us what happened, so we can help.
upi_failure.mode.wrong_pin: I entered the wrong UPI PIN
upi_failure.mode.wrong_pin.a11y: Select: I entered the wrong UPI PIN
upi_failure.mode.app_issue.a11y: Select: my UPI app didn't work
upi_failure.mode.network_issue.a11y: Select: my internet or network dropped
upi_failure.body.insufficient_balance: No problem — this happens. You can add money to your account and try again, or use a different account.
upi_failure.body.wrong_pin: It's easy to mistype a PIN. You can try the payment again whenever you're ready.
upi_failure.body.app_issue: Sometimes a UPI app has trouble. You can try again, or use a different UPI app.
upi_failure.body.network_issue: That's alright — the connection may have dropped. When your internet is back, you can try again.
upi_failure.body.other: Thank you for telling us. You can try again, or reach us and we'll help you through it.
upi_failure.guidance.contact_bank: Your bank can help if the payment keeps failing — they can check your balance or account.
upi_failure.guidance.switch_app: You can try a different UPI app — PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, or BHIM — and pay again.
upi_failure.guidance.retry_text: You can try the UPI payment again:
upi_failure.change_answer_a11y: Choose a different reason for the payment that didn't go through
upi_failure.retry_unavailable: We can't retry the payment from here right now — please call us for help.
upi_failure.retry_failed_again: That didn't work either. You can call us, or pay another way and paste your UTR below.
yogdaan.title: Yogdaan Bahi
yogdaan.columns_a11y: Yogdaan Bahi columns: Date, Family, Pool, Amount, Status
yogdaan.status.green_a11y: Status: confirmed — this contribution has been matched to our bank records
yogdaan.status.yellow_a11y: Status: you told us you paid — we are matching it to our bank records; it is not confirmed yet
yogdaan.status.red_a11y: Status: we found a difference while matching — our team is looking into it
yogdaan.status.grey_a11y: Status: the contribution is on record; only the matching remains
yogdaan.note.unavailable_a11y: The Note for this contribution will be available soon
yogdaan.empty: Your first contribution will appear here
yogdaan.empty_a11y: Your Yogdaan Bahi has no entries yet. Your first contribution will appear here.
yogdaan.load_failed: We couldn't load your Yogdaan Bahi just now. Please try again.
yogdaan.entry_a11y: Open your Yogdaan Bahi — the record of all your contributions
yogdaan.entry_hint: Opens the list of all your contributions
